ov: About 200 species of Old World lizard with independently moving eyes, a projectile tongue and gripping feet and tail. About half of all species live only on Madagascar.

why.p: Chameleons are popular reptile pets, mostly imported from Africa, though stricter rules on wild-caught animals have cut the trade.

rg: Mostly Africa, about half of species only in Madagascar. One species in southern Europe, a few across southern Asia to India and Sri Lanka.
df: Mostly insects, caught with the tongue; the large species also take small vertebrates.
fx: Each eye moves on its own, so a chameleon’s brain handles two separate images until both eyes lock onto prey.
